sources.title: Flexan/FuckYou-v1 · Datasets at Hugging Face
sources.snippet: FuckYou v1 A dataset containing user prompts and AI's confidently wrong and misleading answers. This dataset contains 898 single-turn chats (user, assistant) where the user asks a genuine question and the assistant responds with a completely wrong and/or misleading answer. sources.snippet: GGUF (GPT-Generated Unified Format) is the standard file format for running LLMs locally. Think of it as the .mp3 of AI models: Compressed — 70-85% smaller than the original float16 weights Fast — optimized for CPU and GPU inference Portable — one file contains the entire model Metadata-rich — includes tokenizer, chat template, and model config Every ollama pull downloads a GGUF file ...

sources.title: Where to Download GGUF Models - Best Sources & Direct Links (2025)
sources.snippet: Download GGUF models from HuggingFace, TheBloke, bartowski. Direct links to Mistral 7B, Llama 3.2, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek, Phi-3 — Q4_K_M and Q5_K_M quantized for local AI.
